author: Runumfast
quote: It is a straight upgrade from BOTW. My biggest complaint is the dungeons. There is not a big sense of progression as a result of no item-based progression. It has the same flaws as BOTW, but the increase in tools makes the sandbox so much more fun. If you enjoyed BOTW, you will think this game is better, but for old Zelda fans, it is a bit disappointing because of the Dungeons.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

author: Runumfast
quote: Amazing game, it transformed gaming forever. I will forever cherish and love it
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Runumfast
quote: This game is a masterpiece. What can I say that has not been said already. The remake improves the game in many ways, such as better controls. The environments are amazing and run in 4 K at 60 fps. Which is impressive for being on the Switch 2. Puzzles are simplified a bit, but I do not think that hurts the experience at all. I believe it just improves it for new and returning fans of the game. This is an overall incredible game, and few things could change my mind.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Runumfast
quote: This game is genuinely one of the craziest disappointments of the decade. It is basically a dating simulator and a house-building simulator.  People say to give it the first 10 hours, and that is not acceptable. Who wants to waste the most valuable resource humans have: time? This is the reason indie games have been on the rise: they respect your time and are made with passion. The game also just uses the same formula as the previous GTA games. Sequels are created to reinvent the wheel from the old formula.
